title: Indian Panorama to showcase 25 feature films and 20 non-feature films at 57th IFFI
subtitle:
Five Films nominated for Best Debut Director Award; Five Web Series nominated for Best Web-Series (OTT) Award
‘Dhurandhar (Hindi)’ and ‘Becoming (Ladakhi)’ selected as Opening Films
body_text:
Posted On: 14 NOV 2026 5:24PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2336235 Views: 113 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English
Goa, 14 November 2026 Indian Panorama, a flagship component of the International Film Festival of India (IFFI), will showcase 25 feature films, including five films in the Mainstream Cinema section, and 20 non-feature films for 2026. ‘Dhurandhar’ (Hindi), directed by Aditya Dhar, has been selected as the opening feature film of Indian Panorama 2026, and ‘ Becoming’ (Ladakhi), directed by Ms Leena Yadav, has been selected as the opening non-feature film. The feature-film selection has been made from 404 contemporary Indian feature-film entries, while the 20 non-feature films have been selected from 358 entries. Together, the selections bring a wide range of contemporary Indian filmmaking to the festival, spanning feature and non-feature forms and multiple languages. Indian Panorama aims to select feature and non-feature films of cinematic, thematic and aesthetic excellence for the promotion of film art. The selection is undertaken by separate juries for feature and non-feature films, led by their respective chairpersons. The Best Debut Director of Indian Feature Film Award seeks to encourage fresh perspectives, innovative forms of expression and new talent in Indian cinema. 25 Feature Films Selected for Indian Panorama 2026 The Feature Film Jury, comprising 12 members, was headed by National Film Award-winning film director and producer Shri Madhur Bhandarkar. The selected feature-film package comprises 20 films in the Indian Panorama Feature Film section and five films in the Mainstream Cinema section. Beyond their screening at IFFI, selected films may be presented at international film festivals in India and abroad, Indian Film Weeks held under Bilateral Cultural Exchange Programmes, specialised Indian Film Festivals outside cultural exchange protocols, and special Indian Panorama festivals in India. * * * PIB IFFI Team | Lekshmi Priya/ Praveen/ Darshana Rane
